system.description: This slim holster is designed to hide the presence of a weapon from visual searches and cursory physical searches. It can hold a small weapon, typically a bludgeon, shortblade, sidearm, or thrown blade. The holster must be custom built for the type of weapon. The DC to spot a weapon in a concealed holster is equal to 10 + twice the holster’s tech level (DC 14 for most Tau’ri tech). This DC is increased by the user’s Proficiency bonus if the user is proficient in Sleight of Hand.
